Migrate.// Policy: Validate refuses to start while a module context has a pending migration, so a deployment applies them before the host runs, from CI/CD: tools/ef/module-migrate.sh apply <Provider> "<connection>" for the module contexts, then tools/ef/dual-migrate.sh apply --<provider> (ELSA_SECRETS_EF_<PROVIDER>) for Secrets, which the first script does not cover. Secrets also reads its own MigratePolicy rather than this key, so shells.Production.json sets that one too. AutoMigrate hands migration back to shell activation.
